[[Chuno]] is an arrogant and condescending villager of [[Ronjok]]. He particularly dislikes [[Koss]], most probably due to his affection for [[Melonni]].

*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Marga Coast}} (in [[Ronjok]])

==Dialogue==
Before completing [[Drake in a Cage]]:
:''"I am in charge of defending and securing this village. You think you can do a better job?"''

After completing [[Feeding Frenzy]]:
:''"Ha! It's amazing how similar [[Koss]] and the beast are. They're both savage brutes. I shouldn't badmouth the beast by comparing him to Koss. Obviously, [[Melonni]] is fond of [[Toma]]."''
